title: Ordinary realization of compatible affine-target diagonal orientations
statement: Fix the finite coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions]. Let f:X→Y be separated, finite type and smooth of pure relative dimension d≥0 between Noetherian finite-type k-schemes, with structure map aY:Y→Spec k and a chosen compactification of f. Use the ordinary coefficient object, site comparison and positive Tate twist of [def-pur-diagonal-dualizing-data]. For every finite-type affine target open V let D_V be a normalized diagonal chart of [lem-pur-diagonal-orientation-refinement], and assume Agrees for each inclusion of such affine opens. There is an ordinary-etale isomorphism e:omega0_f≈A_X(d)[2d] whose comparison image, after the canonical unit conversion from omega_f defined with the monoidal unit, restricts on X_V to the specified four-factor theta_V=rho_V alpha_V inverse delta_V beta_V, with the canonical source and Tate pullback comparisons. This statement asserts a prescribed local realization only, with no coordinate-counit normalization or uniqueness clause.

proof.text: Index by all finite-type affine target opens. The finite affine cover from affineTargetDiagonalDnc proves their inverse images cover X. Lift each local theta to ordinary exact-restriction coordinates using chart_lift.

Remove the even shift. The proved finite-Tate induction gives concentration of the target, preserved by exact restriction, and each local isomorphism gives concentration of the source. Ordinary overlap compatibility supplies equality of restricted local isomorphisms.

Apply degreeZeroDerivedMapGluing on the ordinary site to homs and inverses. Its equality test on source and target gives both inverse identities. This produces a global shifted isomorphism, with every prescribed restriction, including outside the initial finite cover.

Lift back through the fully faithful shift equivalence. Naturality of the restriction shift comparison identifies each restriction with b_V. Naturality of the site comparison then gives the exact unit-converted theta equation. No global comparison lift or choice of a bare orientation is used.

proof_origin.note: N4: ordinary-site gluing, explicit inverse equations and shift cancellation; one remaining local overlap-coherence step.

theorem diagonalOrdinaryOrientationGluing (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (d : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y] [HasCompactification f]
    (aY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of P.field.k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType aY] [QuasiCompact aY]
    (D : ∀ (V : Y.affineOpens), (V.1.ι ≫ aY).appTop.hom.FiniteType →
      OrientationRefinement.Chart P f aY d V)
    (hD : ∀ (V V' : Y.affineOpens)
      (hV : (V.1.ι ≫ aY).appTop.hom.FiniteType)
      (hV' : (V'.1.ι ≫ aY).appTop.hom.FiniteType) (h : V'.1 ≤ V.1),
      OrientationRefinement.Agrees P f aY d (D V hV) (D V' hV') h) :
    ∃ e : P.diagonalOrdinaryDualizing f ≅ P.diagonalTwistEtale X d,
      ∀ (V : Y.affineOpens) (hV : (V.1.ι ≫ aY).appTop.hom.FiniteType),
        (OrientationRefinement.pull P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι).mapIso
          ((ProEtale.comparisonUpperStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) X).mapDerivedCategory.mapIso
            ((Etale.rightDerivedUpperShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) f).mapIso
              (Etale.singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) Y).symm ≪≫
                e)) ≪≫
          OrientationRefinement.tate P (f ⁻¹ᵁ V.1).ι (f ≫ aY) d =
        OrientationRefinement.theta P f aY d V (D V hV).geometry (D V hV).betaEtale
